Where Is The Work
On-Site (5 days)
Position Overview
The
Sales Support & Application Engineer – Data Centers
is responsible for supporting the data center business across Türkiye and the Eastern Europe region by delivering strong pre-sales and post-sales coordination, accurate equipment selection, and disciplined project documentation management throughout the full project lifecycle.
This role requires a technically capable, highly organized, and detail-oriented professional who can work closely with sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders. The position is primarily based in the Istanbul office and requires close coordination with the Ankara office.
Key Responsibilities
Support data center projects through accurate equipment selection and application engineering activities.
Provide the sales organization with pre-sales technical and commercial support to help develop projects efficiently and accurately.
Prepare, organize, track, and manage project documentation in a timely and disciplined manner.
Take ownership of documentation, equipment selection, and project coordination for data center opportunities across Türkiye and Eastern Europe.
Monitor and support both pre-sales and post-sales processes to ensure smooth project execution and effective follow-up.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, sales teams, and relevant departments to align on project requirements, deliverables, and timelines.
Work from the Istanbul office while maintaining close collaboration with the Ankara office.
We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.
